base64Converter.title: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
base64Converter.description: Convert UTF-8 text and files with standard Base64 or Base64URL. Distinguish text from binary results and recover from failed copies.

errors.encodeError: Error encoding. Please check your input.
errors.decodeError: Error decoding. Please verify the Base64 format.

whatIs.title: What is Base64?
whatIs.description: Base64 is an encoding scheme that converts binary data to ASCII strings. Widely used in email attachments, web image data URIs, and API communication.

useCases.title: Use Cases
items: Embed images directly in HTML/CSS (Data URI)

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Choose encode or decode, then standard Base64 or Base64URL.
2. Enter text or choose a file, then press the conversion button. Decode files are checked by actual UTF-8 content, size, and Base64 rules rather than their names.
3. Base64URL output can include or omit end padding. File results distinguish raw Base64 from full data URL copy targets.
4. Copy or download the confirmed result. Binary bytes remain downloadable, and failed copies offer manual selection and retry.

tips.title: Tips
items: Base64-encoding an image lets you embed it directly in HTML (``) or CSS (`background-image: url(data:...)`).
You can decode Base64URL-encoded JWT parts, but this does not verify the token signature or authenticity.
Base64 increases data size by about 33%, so consider alternatives when file size matters.

items.q: What is the difference between Base64 and Base64URL?
items.a: Base64URL replaces + and / with - and _. This tool omits = padding in URL output by default and also offers inclusion. Standard output includes required padding. Decoding accepts correctly omitted end padding in both formats.

items.q: Is Base64 a form of encryption?
items.a: No. Base64 is an encoding scheme, not encryption. Anyone can decode it, so it must not be used for security purposes.
Yes. Valid Unicode text is encoded as UTF-8 with whitespace preserved. Decoded bytes that are not valid UTF-8 are offered as a file rather than displayed as successful text.

flow.swap: Use result as the opposite input
flow.convertFailed: Could not convert. Check the input and format, then try again.
flow.downloadFailed: Could not prepare the file. Your result is retained. Try again.
flow.paddingHint: Standard output includes padding. URL output omits it by default.
flow.decodeRules: Both formats accept correctly omitted end padding and ASCII spaces, tabs, line breaks, and form feeds. Other characters and malformed padding are rejected.
flow.dataUrlRule: Data URLs always use standard Base64, regardless of the selected raw format.
flow.fileSourceHint: Converting again uses the same original file bytes.
flow.decodeFileHint: Upload UTF-8 text containing Base64, such as a .txt, .base64, or .b64 file. Its content is checked regardless of the filename.
flow.binary: These bytes are not valid UTF-8 text. You can download the original bytes as a file.
flow.previewFailed: Images with unreadable headers or more than 16,777,216 pixels cannot be previewed. You can still download the result bytes.
flow.changed: The input or options changed. Convert again to update the result.
flow.limits: UTF-8 text, file bytes, and decoded results are limited to 4MiB. Base64 strings are limited to 6MiB.
flow.empty: Enter content or choose a file. Whitespace in text is preserved.
flow.privacy: Content and files are processed in this page and are not stored in the URL or device history. Base64 is not encryption.
